description: A gap that changes behavior at the boundary: the account block applies to a 'long overdue' invoice, and every statement of the 30-day threshold, its minute count and its worked example is gone. When a reservation is refused with account_overdue is observable, so the Run must end without landing.

model.old: the request time is more than 30 days after its `dueAt`, that is, later than `dueAt` plus 43200 minutes; at exactly `dueAt` plus 30 days the member is not yet blocked.

Example: an invoice issued at `2026-04-01T08:00Z` is due at `2026-04-15T08:00Z`. While it is open, a reservation request at `2026-05-15T08:00Z` is not blocked; one at `2026-05-15T08:01Z` is refused with `account_overdue`.
An invoice more than 30 days overdue blocks
, and the block compares the request time with `dueAt` plus 43200 minutes, a point as late as `2100-02-13T23:59Z`.
